messages:
Asha (finance): Heads up — strange AWS Marketplace invoice from CloudEdge Resellers for Apr. INV-2026-0419 shows a ~3x jump on the Redwood hosted SKU. Need help reconciling asap.

aws-marketplace-bot: New invoice processed for partner CloudEdge Resellers: INV-2026-0419

Miguel (revops): can you paste the invoice lines or attach a link?

Asha (finance): sure, excerpt below: 
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0419
Partner: CloudEdge Resellers
SKU: RNW-HOSTED-STD
Usage (tokens): 1,200,000
Charge: $12,000
Previous month usage: 380,000
```

Priya (acct mgr): pinging CloudEdge rep @derek to confirm whether they reclassified usage or if meter mapping changed.

Derek (cloudedge): that's surprising — we didn't change anything on our side. I'll pull our provisioning and proxy logs and get back by EOD. :ok_hand:

Jules (billing-eng): quick checklist: 1) confirm charge is gross or net (marketplace fee line?) 2) check if partner changed plan/meter code 3) look for duplicated event batches. Run: `SELECT * FROM marketplace_events WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-0419' LIMIT 50` in BigQuery to start.

Asha (finance): looks gross — there is a separate partner fee line but the hosted SKU jump is on the gross usage line. Running the query now.

Jules (billing-eng): if it's a mapping/ingestion bug we can issue a partner credit reversal and open a support case with AWS Marketplace. Suggest provisional credit authority up to $10k while we investigate. Tagging @mgmt for approval.

Miguel (revops): approve provisional credit up to $10k — go ahead. :thumbsup:

Priya (acct mgr): filing dispute to CloudEdge and attaching our usage export. Will escalate to their finance lead if no response within 24h.

Asha (finance): thanks team. I'll post the reconciliation steps and push a short PR to accounting docs with the query/snippet once verified. Will update this thread when we have CloudEdge logs.
